name: Zapardiel de la Cañada (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, white and blue with a broad white middle stripe, crossed by a thin orange diagonal line from the upper fly to the lower hoist.
history: Municipal flag of Zapardiel de la Cañada; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: thin diagonal line from the upper fly to the lower hoist
